title: Moonlit Kitchen Vision
description: A person with curly hair stands with their back to the viewer in a dimly lit kitchen, gazing at a large ethereal female face in the night sky that emerges from swirling pink and purple clouds. The kitchen counter holds a glowing blue bong, potted plants, a black raven perched on a bare white tree, and various household items under a starry cosmic ceiling.
prompt: A person with curly hair viewed from behind stands in a mystical kitchen at night, looking toward a giant ethereal woman's face floating in a starry sky surrounded by swirling pink and purple clouds. On the wooden counter is a glowing blue glass bong emitting smoke patterns, several potted plants with red leaves, a black raven perched on a leafless white tree, and another white bird. The scene is illuminated by dramatic red and blue lighting with a cosmic starry ceiling.
